headlines: Treasury yields stayed near multi-year highs in early October (10y about 5.3%), with weak auctions a recurring worry (older reports)

rumors.text: 30-year Treasury auction due in the next hour could move stocks the way yesterday's 10-year auction did
rumors.why: A weak auction would push long yields higher and pressure equities, especially tech

rumors.why: Adds to deficit and long-yield worries, though it is a slow-moving theme
